description: 反向隧道（SOCKS 出口）+ 设备指挥通道 + pi_messenger mesh 桥
descriptionEn: Reverse tunnel: the owner's device dials in (no public exposure, NAT-friendly); pi reaches the owner's network via local SOCKS5 with DNS resolved owner-side. Panel shows tunnel status/connections/token; tunnel_fetch tool for AI probes; device-task model channel UI (manual/auto, v1.2).

settings.hintEn: Auth token lives in plugin storage; changing the port requires CLI reconnect with new address
